Fq#r7bBr;JpXFvXXpkp7.text:
===== BARREL TYPES =====
This is a list of all of the barrels that the players would encounter in Barrel Extravaganza. The barrels all have a falling and rolling variant.

NORMAL: The basic type of barrel. Starts spawning at the start of the game. Deals -1 HP.

LIGHT: Falls slower than the normal barrel, but rolls faster than it. Starts spawning after 20 seconds. Deals -1 HP.

HEAVY: Falls faster than the normal barrel, but rolls slower than it. Starts spawning after 20 seconds. Deals -2 HP due to how bulky it is, even when slowly rolling.

PAUSE: Pauses the player in place when this barrel hits them. The player would be unpaused when they get hit by another barrel. Starts spawning after 45 seconds. It does not deal damage unless the player is already paused and is hit by one. If it does deal damage to the player, then it would deal -1 HP.

BOUNCY: This barrel bounces on the platform. When it is falling, it bounces once, then falls. If it is rolling, then it will bounce on the platform until it reaches the other side. Starts spawning after 45 seconds. Deals -1 HP.

SPIKED: Watch out for this barrel, as it can instantly knock you out of the game and make you lose! Starts spawning after a minute and 30 seconds.

t;MQ(oU?41}KR/;+u4:I.text:
Once you've added yourself to the project you can add yourself to the thumbnail! I recommend grouping your characters in their thumbnail poses before adding them to it to reduce clutter.

===== Make sure you haven't broken any of the rules below before sharing this project. If you have, fix them up or your remix may be declared UNOFFICIAL! =====
Only @ZYellow, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @Twin138956Scratch, @ScratchTeen9300, and @Kyle3912Again (as well as their other accounts) are allowed to break these rules.

1. It is polite and REMIX ETIQUETTE to comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing..."!
2. DO NOT BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES!! That means nothing too scary or vulgar & no swear words!
3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without permission! Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't completely change the project title either!
4. Don't delete or destructively modify anything you didn't make! You are allowed to do this if you need to fix a bug or glitch.
5. Please don't try to make your character(s) more powerful and likely to win than others. Everybody should have equal chances of winning!
6. Don't make your characters too large, that would make it hard to see. If they are too big, resize their costumes, NOT their sprite, so their hitbox remains the same size & Rule #5 isn't broken!
7. I don't recommend adding any singular characters that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 player), unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them.
8. PLEASE DO NOT add any static images for characters.
9. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the Community Guidelines. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to make sure you can't.
10. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so that it can't have too much lag from this project.
11. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it or completely change it altogether!

Oh, and don't delete this comment either.

Q)lcBOI(n)o5?-g:~u1G.text:
Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into either "Add music" block, depending on what scenario it should be for, & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! Running a test recommended!

If the music track or jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020, via the audio-exemption lists & boolean. Same goes for "gets faster" tracks, lyrical music, & non-looping music. Burgnew_On_A_Laptop also recommends you please don't add any more than around 100 music tracks and jingles total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.

Set your character's name, footstep sound set, interval between Run-frame progression, and the number of ouch voice clips here. Fine-tune these things to your liking. The amount of Run-frames you add is calculated automatically now.

NOTICE: If you don't change the character's name from "[ NAME HERE ]" they will not participate in the game! Also, It's recommended you put at least a little bit of color on your character so we can tell if they've been made black-n-white by a Pause Barrel.

Setting the Seconds per Run-frame to a negative value will result in the Run animation being faster than 0 seconds per run frame. Silky smooth.

Here is a list of the footstep sounds you can use:
1 - CARTOON FOOTSTEPS, more defined step sounds used by scratchers like Twin138956Scratch, ScratchTeen9300, and ZYellow.

2 - SCRATCH FOOTSTEPS, the classic footsteps from the Scratch Sound Library.

3 - QUIET FOOTSTEPS, more quiet footstep sounds, used in ZYellow's "Add Yourself in Boulder Attack".

4 - REALISTIC FOOTSTEPS, more realistic and gentle footstep sounds.

ANYTHING ELSE - NO FOOTSTEP NOISES
